desc: Derive the fixed-right-endpoint formula T_R = sum_x max(0, last_R(x) - last_R(x+1)) and the O(1) update when A_R=v.
Implement the O(N) online last-occurrence sweep Python program with stdin/stdout and 64-bit-safe integer arithmetic.
Verify the implementation on the samples and edge cases: N=1, all equal values, all distinct values, boundary values 1 and N, and a negative-delta case.
